subject: website
name: Ben Woodall
summary: Ben Woodall's personal site and blog. It stays at Level 2 because it loads the ethers library from cdnjs.cloudflare.com with no integrity hash when it opens, code the CDN can change at any time. It also reads Ethereum through ethereum.publicnode.com, resolves names through ensdata.net and loads avatars from euc.li.

connections.name: ethers from cdnjs.cloudflare.com
connections.note: Script loaded as code when the page opens, with no integrity hash.

connections.note: Chain reads when the page opens, without a light client.
